features: standard feature (Ling & Templeton 2015; Wang et al. 2017)
Baseline anisotropy vs local shear scale marks shear layers where linear eddy-viscosity stress is wrong.
Wnorm * Umag / (DUDt_mag + gradp_mag + (Snorm + Wnorm + omega) * Umag)
Rotation-advection vs acceleration-plus-pressure marks curvature-dominated recirculation over bumps vs nozzle-like FPG/APG acceleration in CD throat.
Rotation fraction with turbulence frequency marks curvature-dominated recirculation vs attached strain, separating near-wall from free shear.
Wall-bounded velocity vs TKE plus pressure-acceleration scale marks near-wall separation/reattachment vs outer free shear in bumps and CD channel.
Signed APG alignment times pressure-work vs turbulence marks APG separation bubble (+1) vs FPG throat recovery (-1) in CD channel and bumps.
Bounded production-vs-dissipation marks non-equilibrium separation shear and reattachment where equilibrium SST anisotropy is wrong.
Wall-bounded speed vs TKE plus omega*d marks near-wall separation bubble/reattachment (low) vs outer free shear and FPG throat (high).
Signed strain excess vs rotation plus turbulence frequency marks strain-dominated throat vs rotation-dominated bump/CD recirculation curvature.
Inertia acceleration vs pressure force plus turbulent advection marks nozzle-like FPG acceleration vs APG separation bubble where SST stress wrong.
UgradP * d / (abs(UgradP) * d + Umag * k + eps * d)
Signed pressure work vs TKE-advection plus dissipation marks APG separation bubble (+) vs FPG throat recovery (-) in CD channel and bumps.
Wall-scaled rotation vs advection plus TKE marks low-speed recirculation curvature over bumps/CD vs high-speed attached throat.
Net k-budget imbalance vs transport marks non-equilibrium separation shear (Pk>>eps) vs recovery where SST anisotropy is wrong.
Shear timescale vs dissipation+production+advection marks non-equilibrium separation shear and throat acceleration where SST equilibrium fails.
gradp_mag / (gradp_mag + Umag * Snorm + Umag * Wnorm + Umag * omega + DUDt_mag)
Pressure force vs shear-rotation-turbulence inertia marks APG-dominated CD diverging separation vs FPG throat where stress is wrong.
SST eddy-viscosity ratio marks limiter-active APG/separation zones where linear Boussinesq anisotropy is most wrong.
x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)

proposal.risk_audit: All three checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L; denominators k*Umag, eps, Snorm*Umag >0 at cell centers so finite on >99% and non-constant; orderings distinct from q_pgrad/q_pnorm/q_qcrit/q_tscale and target APG separation, non-equilibrium shear, and acceleration/curvature driving worst heldout errors.

features.name: f_apg_drive

features.name: f_noneq

features.name: f_acc_shear

features: x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)

proposal.risk_audit: All three checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L; denominators k>0 eps>0 so finite on >99% points, numerators bounded; normalizations (d/k, sqrt(k)/eps) differ from f_apg_drive, f_acc_shear, q_conv to limit collinearity; magnitude forms complement signed APG; scale handled by x/(|x|+median) mapping.

features.name: f_pg_k

features: x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)

proposal.risk_audit: Both features are dimensionless by unit balance (UgradP,k*Snorm,eps all L2/T3; tau_dev*omega,k*Snorm,eps all L2/T3). Denominators contain +eps>0 so strictly positive, guaranteeing finite everywhere including walls and recirculation; not constant (signed APG and stress ratio vary). Ordering distinct from q_ti/f_noneq/f_acc_tke and supersedes f_apg_drive. Drop f_apg_drive (gain 0, superseded, Umag denominator blows up in bubble) and q_qcrit (gain 0, redundant with I1/I2).

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed scalars are dimensionless under U->2U, L->3L (numerator and denominator share L^2/T^3, L^2/T^2, L/T respectively). They target worst heldout converging_diverging_channel (0.563) FPG throat vs APG separation, complementing kept f_pg_k/f_tau_shr and replacing dropped harmful/redundant f_sep_adv/q_pnorm/q_conv.
